summary.stack: local: PostgreSQL 16 copy of staging + PostgREST 12.2.3 + local sign-in shim + production build in headless Chromium (Playwright)

defects.title: An Admin cannot save a recall
defects.seen: Alpha Admin filled Add recall and pressed Save recall. The API answered 403 and the page said "You do not have permission to do that." No row was written.
defects.cause: src/pages/RecallTracker.jsx line 444 sends country: form.country || profile?.country. profiles.country is an array, recalls.country is a single text value, so the row fails the country write policy (recalls_country_write). The same insert with country null succeeds for the same user (checked in SQL). In production today only a super admin passes because that policy lets super admins through.

defects.module: breakdowns, driver_training, dvir, equipment, retread_claims, rotation, service_requests, shifts, tyre_pool, warranty
defects.title: Saved table views call a table that is not in the database
defects.seen: Every page that uses saved views requests /rest/v1/user_view_prefs and gets 404, with a console error. The page still works; saved views do not.
defects.cause: supabase/migrations/20260921090000_user_view_prefs.sql exists in the repository but the table is absent from the staging schema, which was copied from the production catalog. The migration appears not to be applied.

defects.title: Request numbers carry another company's prefix
defects.seen: Alpha Readymix received request number GC/RFR/0001/1126.
defects.cause: Database function next_rfr_no falls back to the fixed prefix GC when the company has no row in repair_request_number_config. A new customer has no row.

defects.title: Country on a warranty claim is free text and a wrong value reads as a permission error
defects.seen: With a Country value that is not one of the user's countries the save answered 403 and "You do not have permission to do that." With KSA the same claim saved.
defects.cause: The Country field in the Add Claim form is a text box; the country write policy refuses unknown values and the message does not say which field is wrong.

defects.title: No role guard on two routes
defects.seen: Alpha Tyre Man opened /tyre-pool and /warranty and saw the page with its Add button. Whether a Tyre Man can save there was not tested.
defects.cause: These two routes have no RoleRoute in src/App.jsx. This may be intended; it should be a decision, not an accident.

defects.title: Most restored modules are Admin only
defects.seen: Alpha Manager got Access Restricted on 19 routes. Restoring the module switch alone gives managers nothing on those pages.
